article.title: 贊助案例：G-NiiB整理網站結構，回應AI搜尋
article.title_en: Sponsored case: G-NiiB restructures its site for AI search
article.summary: WPP Media Hong Kong在贊助文章介紹G-NiiB的AI搜尋工作，包含結構化資料、FAQ及商品頁面的整理。
article.summary_en: WPP Media Hong Kong described G-NiiB's structured data, FAQs and product-page changes in a sponsored case article.
highlights: 案例列出標準網址、商品圖片描述及分散頁面整合等調整。
11月20日發布的文章描述較早的2026年4至6月評估，並披露WPP贊助。
highlights_en: The work covers canonical URLs, image descriptions and consolidation of fragmented pages.
Published November 20, the sponsored article describes an earlier April–June 2026 evaluation.
article.why: AI答案能否辨識一致的商品資料，與網站結構及內容來源有關；品牌搜尋團隊可決定哪些重複商品頁需要先整合。
article.why_en: Brand search teams can assess which duplicate product pages to consolidate so AI systems can identify consistent product information.
article.next_step: 挑一組內容分散的商品頁，比對標準網址、FAQ及圖片描述，再以固定問題記錄AI答案使用了哪些來源。
article.next_step_en: Compare canonical URLs, FAQs and image descriptions for one fragmented product group, then log which sources fixed AI questions retrieve.
article.detail: 這是供應商披露的案例機制，並非本刊獨立成效測試。結構化資料是供搜尋系統讀取的欄位，標準網址則用來辨識主要頁面。團隊可把頁面整合與AI引用觀察分開記錄，保留問題、模型及日期，避免把同一期間的其他行銷變化都歸因於網站調整。原文由WPP Media Hong Kong贊助。
article.detail_en: This is a vendor-described mechanism, not our independent outcome test. Structured data supplies machine-readable fields; canonical URLs identify main pages. Log consolidation separately from AI citation observations, retaining question, model and date. The original article is sponsored by WPP Media Hong Kong.
